The 2019 Chevrolet Tahoe Premier 4WD delivers full-size SUV capability, premium luxury, and advanced technology in a package designed to comfortably handle everything from family road trips to towing and daily driving. Finished in Iridescent Pearl Tricoat with a Cocoa/Dune interior, this Tahoe combines upscale styling with the versatility that has made it one of Chevrolets most popular SUVs.

Power comes from the proven 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission and a 2-speed transfer case. The Max Trailering Package adds enhanced towing capability with a Trailer Brake Controller, upgraded cooling systems, and a 3.42 rear axle ratio, making this Tahoe well-equipped for hauling boats, campers, and trailers. Magnetic Ride Control Suspension further enhances ride quality and handling by continuously adapting to changing road conditions.

Inside, the Premier trim surrounds occupants with full-feature leather-appointed front bucket seats, heated and ventilated front seats, heated second-row captains chairs, power-folding third-row seating, memory settings, a heated steering wheel, power-adjustable pedals, tri-zone automatic climate control, and a power tilt-and-telescoping steering column. The spacious cabin provides premium comfort for passengers in all three rows.

Technology features include Chevrolet Infotainment with Navigation, an 8-inch touchscreen display, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth audio streaming, wireless charging, HD Radio, a Bose Centerpoint 10-speaker surround sound system, a configurable driver information center with Head-Up Display, and 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot capability.

The Sun, Entertainment and Destinations Package adds a power sunroof and rear seat entertainment system, creating an exceptional environment for long-distance travel and family adventures.

Safety and driver-assistance features include Adaptive Cruise Control with Forward Automatic Braking, Forward Collision Alert, Lane Keep Assist, Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, Front and Rear Park Assist, Rear Vision Camera, Collision Avoidance Sensor, IntelliBeam automatic headlamps, and Teen Driver technology.

Additional highlights include 22-inch Silver wheels, power-retractable assist steps, hands-free power liftgate, rain-sensing wipers, HID headlamps, fog lamps, deep-tinted glass, roof rails, remote start, keyless entry with push-button start, and an auto-locking rear differential.

This Tahoe was equipped with premium factory equipment including the Sun, Entertainment and Destinations Package, Max Trailering Package, Magnetic Ride Control Suspension Package, Adaptive Cruise Control with Forward Automatic Braking, Rear Seat Entertainment System, Power Sunroof, Bose Centerpoint Surround Sound System, Head-Up Display, Heated and Ventilated Front Seats, Heated Second-Row Seats, and 22-inch Silver Wheels.

The Chevrolet Tahoe has earned a reputation for exceptional passenger space, towing capability, and long-term durability. The Premier trim represents the top of the Tahoe lineup, offering luxury SUV comfort while maintaining the capability and versatility expected from a full-size Chevrolet SUV.

The 2016 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon in Granite Crystal Metallic is a rugged and highly capable off-road SUV built for adventure, durability, and everyday versatility. With its bold Granite Crystal Metallic exterior, this Wrangler combines a tough, trail-ready appearance with a sleek and modern metallic finish that gives it a distinctive presence both on and off the road.

Powered by a dependable 3.6-liter V6 engine paired with a manual or automatic transmission, the Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon delivers strong performance and the kind of low-end torque needed for serious off-road driving. Its legendary 4x4 capability is enhanced by Jeeps Rock-Trac® heavy-duty transfer case, locking front and rear differentials, electronic sway bar disconnect, and high ground clearance, making it one of the most capable factory off-road vehicles available.

The exterior design stays true to the iconic Jeep Wrangler style, featuring removable doors, a removable top, round headlights, a seven-slot grille, and rugged body construction designed for durability in harsh conditions. The four-door Unlimited configuration provides extra space for passengers and cargo while still maintaining excellent off-road agility. The Granite Crystal Metallic paint adds a refined touch to its otherwise aggressive and utilitarian design.

Inside, the cabin is built with durability and comfort in mind. The 2016 Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon offers seating for up to five passengers with supportive seats and easy-to-clean materials designed for outdoor use. While rugged in nature, the interior still provides modern conveniences such as air conditioning, power windows and locks, Bluetooth connectivity, a touchscreen infotainment system, USB ports, and steering wheel-mounted controls, depending on configuration.

Safety and control features include stability control, traction control, hill start assist, and advanced braking systems that help provide confidence on uneven terrain and everyday roads alike. The Wranglers solid construction and off-road engineering make it especially suited for drivers who enjoy exploring trails, beaches, mountains, and other challenging environments.

The 2016 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon in Granite Crystal Metallic is an excellent choice for those who want a true off-road SUV with iconic styling and proven capability. With its rugged design, advanced 4x4 systems, spacious interior, and strong performance, it delivers a driving experience focused on freedom, adventure, and reliability in any environment.

  • Distance pacing cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. Distance pacing cruise control, your ultimate co-pilot.
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
  • Power open and close liftgate - On-demand access. When your arms are full of cargo, the last thing you want to do is set it all down just to open the liftgate, then pick it all back up to load it in. By remotely opening and closing, power liftgate lets you skip straight to the loading. It also eliminates the awkward stretch to reach up for the liftgate to close it. Load and go with power open and close liftgate.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.

Certified! The 2018 Toyota RAV4 Adventure AWD is a versatile and rugged compact SUV designed for drivers who want everyday practicality combined with enhanced capability and adventurous styling. Its Dynamic Torque Control All-Wheel Drive system, along with selectable Eco and Sport driving modes, provides confident traction and control in changing road and weather conditions. The Adventure trim stands out with bold styling that includes 18-inch black alloy wheels, roof rails, a rear spoiler, fog lights, privacy glass, and distinctive exterior accents that emphasize its outdoor-ready personality. Inside, the spacious cabin offers dual-zone automatic climate control, a leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio and Bluetooth® controls, reclining and fold-flat rear seats, multiple power outlets, and a versatile cargo area designed to accommodate gear for any adventure. Additional premium features include heated front seats, a heated leather-wrapped steering wheel, a power-adjustable driver's seat, a height-adjustable power liftgate, Smart Key access, and advanced infotainment with connected navigation, SiriusXM®, Bluetooth® connectivity, and smartphone integration. Safety features include Toyota Safety Sense™ P with Pre-Collision System with Pedestrian Detection, Lane Departure Alert with Steering Assist, Dynamic Radar Cruise Control, Automatic High Beams, Blind Spot Monitor, Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, a backup camera, and Toyotas Star Safety System.
